turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text:
I was charged a late fee of $39 even though my autopay is on.
It has happened twice now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry about that, let me look at the account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I just want the fee reversed and autopay fixed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My   debit card was declined at the grocery store  and the app shows an error.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There is a temporary block after a security alert; I have removed it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thank you, that was quick.
